facts.fact: Maurice Info reports MauPass, a national digital identity platform, lets citizens and residents sign in securely using their national identity card or passport to access government e-services.
Maurice Info reports MauPass gives access to various government e-services with a single secure login, and the minister says more services will be added soon.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation

MUS.note: The document does not mention civil register and ID links.

facts.fact: Maurice Info reports government e-services are already available online, citing the recent launch of an online driving licence system, with more services to be added soon; no count is given.

MUS.note: No enrolment count or share is given.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number is described.
MauPass is described as a digital identity login; no statement on the national ID system's issuance, biometrics or certification.
